candidates.name: Read-only aggregate preparation and recycling counters
candidates.purpose: After installed hardware/ABI and memory-budget validation, distinguish prepared-state changes, guarded queue-head consumption and drain cleanup using aggregate counters.
evidence: Three real calls from59042 reach RAM20000AC6 with the original incoming record
State1 hands off the queue buffer;other states use the frame buffer
5774E drains two separate queues and releases the current node buffer conditionally
constraints: Unimplemented;no instrumentation,live telemetry or BLE commands
Aggregate counts only;no payloads,addresses,security records or device identity
Validate actual event/IRQ binding,custom allocator lifetime,RAM/Flash budget and callback ABI first
Do not call numeric completion status a physical ACK/CRC proof or diagnose historical OTA letterE
Do not change ownership,force queue release or add automatic retries
